title: Tacos in Pasta Shells
description: These tacos in pasta shells are easy and fun to make. Jumbo shells get stuffed with beef, cheese, and chili seasoning, and more before getting baked.

steps.text: Brown beef in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. Add cream cheese, salt, and chili powder; mix and simmer for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes; drain. Toss cooked shells in butter.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Fill shells with beef mixture and arrange in a 9x13-inch baking dish; pour taco sauce over shells. Cover with foil and bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and top with Cheddar cheese, Monterey Jack cheese, and then tortilla chips. Return the dish to the oven to cook for 15 minutes more.
Top with sour cream and serve.

video.description: Please the adults and the kids at dinnertime with this easy family-friendly recipe full of Mexican flavors that everyone craves. Cook up ground beef, then simmer with cream cheese, salt and chili powder. Cook large pasta shells and mix with butter. Fill up the pasta shells with the beef mixture, cover with taco sauce and bake, then top with Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses and crispy tortilla chips and bake some more. Serve with sour cream, green onions, tomatoes, lettuce, black olives and hot sauce!
